affinity.notes: Gold and stone communicate rank and culture more than a discrete elemental affinity.

anatomy.notes: The tall humanoid body, crown, hands, and staff-like vertical silhouette remain coherent within the ornament.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "ritual caster and summoner" semantically communicates Four-Cartouche Sarcophagus Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The ceremonial pose strongly sells authority, but no distinct spell source, attack motion, or vulnerable feature is apparent.

finish.notes: Carved symbols, wrappings, metallic details, and architecture share a polished visual language.

framing.notes: Strong axial symmetry and surrounding attendants establish scale without clipping the figure.

identity.notes: Blind perception "mummified pharaoh-priest" semantically identifies mummies/mummy-god-king.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
